sample_unit: fundus images (test set from 1094 total; test set size not reported)

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of GPT-4o versus fine-tuned ResNet and human ophthalmologists on same test images
links.effect: GPT-4o accuracy 85.9% (Kappa 0.72), specificity 78.9%, PPV 73.7%; ResNet 99.5% (Kappa 0.99); ophthalmologists 96.0% (Kappa ≈ 0.92). GPT-4o underperformed both.
links.quote: GPT-4o achieved moderate diagnostic accuracy and substantial agreement with the ground truth, but it underperformed compared to both a domain-specific ResNet model and human ophthalmologists.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of GPT-4o versus a fine-tuned ResNet CNN and human ophthalmologists on a dataset of fundus images for papilledema detection without testing specific deployment safeguards or practices.
